subject: EMEA/APAC forecast sanitation — owner swaps & commit asks
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: EMEA/APAC forecast sanitation — owner swaps & commit asks

Team —

Quick regional pulse: finance needs a cleaned commit set by EOD Friday so revenue can finalize invoicing windows for next month. I did a pass on stage ownership and there are ~12 accounts in EMEA/APAC with stale owners or conflicting owners in HubSpot.

Asks (short):
- Please open the tracker (attached) and confirm owner swaps where you are listed as the new owner. If you disagree, add a note in the comment column.
- For any account you plan to push to Commit (Commit/Commit(soft) stages), update the "Commit rationale" column and set a clear close-by date.
- Flag any deals with legal/PO blockers — we will escalate to procurement by Thursday.

Priority: Nimbus Health, three mid-size deals in the UK and DACH — those need final owner confirmation and stage sanity.

Attachments: EMEA_owner_swap_tracker.xlsx (master sheet)

I will run a short roll-call on Thursday 08:30 UTC to confirm last changes. If you cannot make the call, add comments in the sheet and reply here.

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Revenue Ops (EMEA)
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 12:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: EMEA/APAC forecast sanitation — owner swaps & commit asks

Alex —

Thanks for running this. I reviewed the tracker and have three quick notes:

1) Nimbus Health — currently owned by external AE (Rajesh) but support asked us to move to a single owner; I propose I own it through close. I updated the tracker with my name and put a tentative close date of 2026-09-07.
2) DACH-345 (internal id) — legal says contract review will take at least 10 business days. I marked it "legal-blocker" and added the expected PO ETA.
3) EMEA-BlueTech — looks like a duplicate record (HubSpot linked two opportunities). I flagged both and suggested merging under the larger seat count record; see comment in the sheet.

If anyone wants to push any of these to Commit this week, call it out here so I can clear dependencies.

On the roll-call: I can cover UK/Ireland and DACH accounts.

—Mina
Senior AM, EMEA
Redwood Inference

All —

I pushed updates for five accounts (rows 12–16) where ownership had been split between solutions and field reps. Proposed new owners are in the tracker; summary below: 

- Nimbus Health (UK) -> Mina Haddad (confirmed)
- BlueTech Enterprise -> Vanessa Ortiz (I will own through PO)
- DACH-345 -> Karthik Iyer suggested as escalation owner (legal already looped)
- APAC-Med1 -> keep with field AE (no swap)
- EMEA-SMB-002 -> move to SDR-led nurture (set Stage: Qualification)

Two asks for the group: 
1) If you mark anything as Commit please paste the short close rationale here (1–2 lines). Finance will use that text for recognition.
2) Can we lock any stage changes after Thursday 17:00 UTC so finance has a stable cut?

I attached a quick snapshot for my accounts to show revenue cadence (no PII).

—Vanessa
Head of Field Ops, EMEA
Redwood Inference

- Karthik: if you are comfortable being the escalation owner for DACH-345, please reply with "+1" so I can finalize the swap.

+1 on DACH-345 as escalation owner. I reviewed the legal notes and am comfortable taking point to drive close once PO is in flight.

I approved the owner swaps in the tracker and attached a final snapshot for finance (APAC_commit_snapshot.pdf) plus the updated owner sheet (EMEA_owner_swap_tracker.xlsx) with my sign-off column filled. Finance: please use the attached snapshot as the source of truth for this cut.

One ask from finance/ops: can the org commit to not changing commit-stage entries after Friday 17:00 UTC unless there's a documented reason (legal/PO) and an explicit reply chain? We need that discipline to avoid churn in recognition.

I'll be on the roll-call but should be brief.

Thanks —
